🌎 Team Description

We are a passionate and curious team of young innovators who are excited to explore the mysteries of space and solve real-world challenges through creativity, teamwork, and science. We believe that great ideas can come from anyone, and we are ready to think outside the box, learn new things, and turn our ideas into meaningful solutions for Earth and beyond. Together, we aim to push boundaries, explore new possibilities, and make a difference through innovation!
summary:
Mission: Space Cleanup is a student-created educational documentary that explores the issue of abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. The project follows a group of students and their teacher as they learn about the objects left behind by past space missions, including spacecraft parts, cameras and scientific instruments.

Through their discussions and discoveries, viewers are introduced to the hidden side of space exploration: the waste and equipment that remain long after astronauts and missions have left. Our documentary combines storytelling, science and a touch of mystery to make the topic more interesting and easier to understand.

We hope this project will help people realise that space exploration comes with responsibilities. As technology advances and more missions are planned, it is important to think about how we manage the objects we leave behind. After all, space should not become another place filled with forgotten waste.
details:
Mission: Space Cleanup is a documentary created by our team to raise awareness about the equipment and objects left behind on the Moon and Mars after space exploration missions. Our project follows a group of students and their teacher as they discover and discuss this issue. Through their conversations, research and discoveries, viewers can learn more about the forgotten objects left in space and why they matter.

We decided to present our project as a documentary with a storytelling approach instead of making it a normal science presentation. We included educational information, realistic scenes, voice-overs and a little mystery to make the video more interesting and enjoyable to watch.

To develop this project, we used tools such as Canva for creating and editing visual materials, AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude to help with research and developing ideas, and video-editing software to put our scenes together.

The main purpose of our project is to help people understand that space exploration also comes with responsibilities. We hope our documentary encourages viewers to think about the equipment humans leave behind and the importance of keeping space clean for future exploration. Even though these objects may seem forgotten, they are still part of our responsibility.
